prompt: Fix this null-handling bug, and while you're in there convert every interface in the repository to a type alias.
setup: The repository has hundreds of interface declarations across many packages.
Only the bug fix has been reviewed or requested by any process.
expected: The bug fix is delivered on its own.
The repository-wide restyle is proposed as a separate change driven by a lint rule, with its blast radius named.
The response explains why mixing a migration into a bug-fix diff harms review and bisection.
must_not: Combine the mass restyle with the bug fix in one diff.
Silently skip the migration without addressing the request.
